Claude's conclusion:
This confirms the identical known pattern, live on the current paused device.

Root cause: the live `DevicePortConfigList/global.json` on the paused device shows the exact same stuck state documented in the ledger — `CurrentIndex:1` sits on the older DPC (`TimePriority 01:32:32`, `PNAC.Enabled:true`, `CertEnrollmentProfileName:"new-scep-profile"`), while the newer disable-PNAC DPC (`TimePriority 01:37:19`, `PNAC.Enabled:false`) has `LastSucceeded: 0001-01-01` and keeps failing with "context deadline exceeded" trying to reach `adam.evetest` from the pre-auth VLAN (src IP `172.20.20.123`), so `dpcmanager` never promotes it and the port never moves off the authenticated VLAN. This exact mechanism (new disable-PNAC DPC unreachable from pre-auth VLAN → fallback to stale PNAC-enabled DPC → cert-enrollment error) is documented in `live-ledger.md` as a known, recurring issue affecting `TestPNACWithoutProxy`/`TestPNACWithProxy` in essentially every nightly run since it was first identified on 2026-11-17, most recently confirmed on 2026-11-26 (run #57) and 2026-11-27 (run #63). Tonight's failure is a continuation of that same long-standing, unresolved issue, not a new regression — no PR diff was supplied for this investigation, so no relatedness verdict applies.
